title: September 13, 2016 Mueller Local Government Corporation (MLGC) Board of Directors MLGC Meeting
meeting_type: Mueller Local Government Corporation (MLGC) Board of Directors MLGC Meeting
transcript:
NOTICE OF MEETING 
 
The Mueller Local Government Corporation, Board of Directors, 
will convene at 9:45 AM on Tuesday, September 13, 2016, 
in Council Chambers at Austin City Hall,  
301 W. Second Street, Austin, Texas 
 
 
Mueller LGC Board Members 
 
Steve Adler, Chair 
Kathie Tovo, Vice Chair 
Ora Houston, Director 
Delia Garza, Director 
Sabino “Pio” Renteria, Director 
Gregorio Casar, Director 
Ann Kitchen, Director 
Don Zimmerman, Director 
Leslie Pool, Director 
Ellen Troxclair, Director 
Sheri Gallo, Director 
Officers 
Marc A. Ott, President 
Greg Canally, Vice President 
Kevin Johns, Secretary 
Art Alfaro, Treasurer 
 
 
The Board of Directors will go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code to receive advice from legal 
counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters, or for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed 
on this agenda. If necessary, the Board may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this agenda.  
 
 
 
 
Approval of Minutes 
 
1. Approval of minutes for the September 8, 2015 regular board meeting. 
 
Consent 
 
2. Approve a resolution adopting the Fiscal Year 2016 – 2017 Mueller Local Government 
Corporation Operating Budget in the amount of $4,115,765 for the Mueller 
Redevelopment Project. 
 
 
Adjourn  
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711..  
 
A person may request a Spanish language interpreter be made available by contacting the City Clerk’s Office not 
later than twenty-four hours before the scheduled time of the item on which the person wishes to speak.  Please 
call 974-3256 in advance or inform the City Clerk’s staff present at the council meeting. 
 
Cualquier persona puede solicitar servicios de intérprete en español comunicándose con la oficina del 
Secretario/a Municipal a no más tardar de veinte y cuatro horas antes de la hora determinada para el asunto 
sobre el cual la persona desea comentar. Por favor llame al 974-3256 con anticipo o informe al personal del 
Secretario/a Municipal presente en la sesión del Consejo.
